submitted.rationale: EQE increased steadily with Sb content: 0.0087% at Cr0.51Sb0.49, 0.022% at Cr0.41Sb0.59 and 0.064% at Cr0.30Sb0.70. XRD shows the rutile (Cr,Sb)O2-type phase is present across this range. The rutile peaks shift to lower Q as Sb increases, which fits Sb-rich alloying. Index 20 had the highest EQE of the three measured compositions.

rejected.reason: Near-stoichiometric CrSbO4, single rutile phase, but lowest measured EQE (0.0087%).
Measured EQE 0.022%, about 3x lower than index 20.
Cr-rich; XRD shows a Cr2O3 secondary phase. Not measured because EQE fell as Cr content rose.

rejected.hypothesis: Sb-richer compositions (21-27) may be better still
rejected.reason: Could not test: the merit budget ran out. XRD of index 21 shows a secondary Sb-oxide phase appearing.
